The '''mother-rock''' was a [[red]] colored [[Mineral/Legends|stone]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] believed that the stone possessed healing powers.
